dedupe_keys.name: a database of seismic designs nonlinear models and seismic responses for steel moment resisting frame buildings

description: A Database of Seismic Designs, Nonlinear Models, and Seismic Responses for Steel Moment Resisting Frame Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Henry Burton, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This database contains 621 special steel moment resisting frames that have been designed in accordance with modern codes and standards, the corresponding nonlinear structural models, and seismic responses (i.e., peak story drifts, peak floor accelerations, and residual story drifts) for a record-set consisting of 240 ground motions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-8yc7-1285. Keywords: database, special steel moment resisting frames, seismic design, nonlinear structural model, seismic response. Published 2020-03-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
